defect: Board composition reporting added facing margins in degrees to spatial margins in millimetres, then labeled the sum and minimum mm. Unresolved facing's finite -90 sentinel was also included as a measured margin.
change: Replace the mixed-unit reporting API with distinct distance_mm and facing_degrees summaries, each with measured/unresolved populations, sum and optional minimum. Empty/fully unresolved groups have no minimum. Non-finite margins and explicit UNRESOLVED sentinels are not measurements. Unsupported kinds and sum overflow reject. The construction profiler emits explicitly unit-labeled summaries.

verification.oracle_integrity: Frozen historical files unchanged. Every term evaluation, verdict, intrusion and airwire result remains exact. Only the old invalid summary line is excluded from historical report comparison; the two new summaries are independently checked against those exact evaluations and hand-computed unit/adversarial cases.

remaining_related_work: The separate compose-repair ledger and candidate ranking also use mixed-unit aggregate margins. Those consumers use a different API and are not corrected by this batch. Repair ordering must be redesigned explicitly and tested for dimensional consistency, rather than silently substituting a new scalar. Prior commentary that the issue was reporting-only was too narrow.
limits: No placement rule, acceptance threshold, fallback ceiling or layout changed. Construction screens are not a new full board qualification or controlled timing comparison. The overall engineering goal remains incomplete.
